title: Greywater Bay Rising Anew
author: Ansel Blackwood
blurb: August Underhill, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
